Description
Returns the event name of the current context.
Note: All XML commands are unavailable beginning in v10.
Syntax
XML
::
event
XML::event
Returns the event name of the current context.
Examples
when
XML_BEGIN_DOCUMENT
{
XML
::
subscribe
allevent
}
when
XML_EVENT
{
log
local0.
"Within XML event : [XML::event]"
}
